name: stay
description: The Stay film. Its one Bevy plugin: bevy_fft (mate-h, MIT, Bevy 0.20), a GPU FFT ocean with a Jacobian foam mask, forked in vendor/bevy_fft for the sea shot: shaders embedded, the surface tiled by position, and one Sea component (src/ocean/sea.rs) a scene sets. bevy-aqua's port (vendor/bevy-aqua, studies/bevy-aqua-bevy-0.20.patch) compiles but its 30 shaders still need converting to WESL.

sea.proof: draws an ocean: needs the renderer and its compute passes
